ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5 with materially lower inference cost
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters reported Claude Opus 5.5 delivers performance comparable to Anthropic's high-end system while costing about 40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads. It is priced at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens and is available through AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Alibaba unveils Zhenwu V900 AI chip and large data-center expansion plan
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: AP reported Alibaba says its Zhenwu V900 is roughly three times as powerful as its prior chip and outlined plans to expand data-center capacity toward 20 GW by 2032, underscoring rising Chinese domestic AI compute competition before the Trump-Xi meeting.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Semiconductor leadership persists for a sixth straight session
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Barron's reported the PHLX Semiconductor Index gained about 1.1% for a sixth consecutive advance. NVIDIA, AMD and TSM ADR all gained, while Microsoft lagged.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Trump-Xi meeting remains the biggest near-term chip-policy event
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Reuters market coverage said investors are focused on the upcoming Trump-Xi meeting, with the trade truce, AI collaboration/safety and technology restrictions all potential market-moving issues.

breaking_news.headline: Nasdaq extends record run while the broad market stalls
breaking_news.market_impact: Nasdaq +0.45% to 27,244.28, while S&P 500 was essentially flat and Dow fell 0.36%. The divergence shows AI/semiconductor leadership remains strong but market breadth is less convincing.

breaking_news.headline: Saudi East-West pipeline restart and Iran diplomacy reduce oil risk premium
breaking_news.market_impact: Reuters reported Saudi Arabia restarted the East-West pipeline at reduced capacity and Iran signaled a possible Hormuz reopening under conditions. Active November WTI settled around $90.52, helping keep the U.S. 10-year yield below 5%.

breaking_news.headline: Taiwan stocks set a closing high but reverse sharply from an intraday record
breaking_news.market_impact: TAIEX closed 47,800.17 (+0.17%) after touching 48,601.53. Breadth was weak with 398 advancers versus 667 decliners despite foreign net buying around NT$44.7B.

earnings_summary.last_24h: AutoZone reported fiscal Q4 net sales of $6.595B (+5.6%), diluted EPS $56.05, gross margin 53.3% and constant-currency total-company same-store sales +1.5%. KB Home reported Q3 revenue $1.30B (-20% YoY), diluted EPS $1.05, deliveries 2,732 (-19%), housing gross margin 16.5%, net orders 2,604 (-12%) and backlog $2.05B (+3% value).
earnings_summary.guidance_watch: KB Home said housing conditions have weakened since June as mortgage rates, affordability and broader uncertainty weigh on buyers. It maintained FY2026 deliveries at 10,500-11,000 and narrowed housing revenue guidance to $4.90B-$5.10B with housing gross margin 16.0%-16.2%. Upcoming focus shifts to General Mills/Cintas/Paychex on Sep23 and Darden/Costco on Sep24.

narration_points: 美股9月22日呈現明顯分化：Nasdaq再漲0.45%至27,244.28創收盤新高，S&P 500幾乎持平，道瓊則跌0.36%，資金仍集中AI與半導體。
風險資產的支撐仍來自油價與長債沒有再惡化：活躍11月WTI約90.52美元，10年債殖利率日線約4.931%，仍守在5%心理線下方。
半導體連續第六天走強，SOX約漲1.1%；NVIDIA收228.91美元、AMD 623.77美元、TSM ADR 451.89美元，其中AMD已在目前52週區間約99.8%。
Anthropic推出Claude Opus 5.5，宣稱典型工作負載成本較Opus 5低約40%，並直接上架AWS、Google Cloud與Microsoft Azure，AI推論價格效能競爭再加速。
Alibaba推出Zhenwu V900並規劃大幅擴充資料中心容量，顯示中國AI算力自主化正在加速，本週Trump-Xi會談的晶片與AI政策風險同步升高。
台股9月22日收47,800.17點、漲0.17%創收盤新高，但盤中48,601.53點後大幅拉回，且下跌家數多於上漲家數；外資仍買超約447億元。
TX 202610日盤收48,243點、漲190點，近月總OI 102,946口；外資淨OI降至-75,568口，較前日增加1,487口淨空。
9月23 session夜盤在05:00已結束，但cutoff前未取得可獨立驗證的最終OHLC與成交量，因此canonical保持null，只允許GitHub以同一session官方資料補值；TAIFEX本來就沒有獨立夜盤OI。
財報方面AutoZone EPS 56.05美元、銷售65.95億美元；KB Home營收年減20%至13億美元，房屋毛利率16.5%，公司明確表示高房貸利率與可負擔性正在壓抑需求。
今天09:45 ET看美國Flash PMI，接著9月24日初領失業金、新屋銷售與Costco財報，9月25日耐久財；另需盯9月24日Trump-Xi會談對晶片出口與AI規則的訊號。
